acip: 'DIR 'GREL PA DANG BSTUN NA, ,KHYOD KYI DBANG BLO'I YUL GTAD JI LTA BA, ,DE LTAR MI SDUG YID CAN DE BZHIN DU, ,YUL DER BLO GTAD CIG SHOS RNAMS LA YANG, ,SKYE 'GYUR DE NI BRDZUN PAR YANG MI 'GYUR, ZHES PA'I 'GYUR CIG THOB PAR SNANG NGO,,
english: If we were to match these thoughts up to the autocommentary at this point, then it would seem that we could come up with a translation of the same lines as follows— You direct your awareness Of the powers of sense In a certain way, And they take on thus A certain aspect; Just so, When the mind is directed Towards a certain object, Then it should arise For the other ones as well; Neither would this be Deceptive.
wylie: 'dir 'grel pa dang bstun na, ,khyod kyi dbang blo'i yul gtad ji lta ba, ,de ltar mi sdug yid can de bzhin du, ,yul der blo gtad cig shos rnams la yang, ,skye 'gyur de ni brdzun par yang mi 'gyur, zhes pa'i 'gyur cig thob par snang ngo
